issues.issue: Should the Court decide the appeal on its merits even though it is moot?
issues.applicant_position: Appellants ask the Court to exercise its discretion and decide the appeal on the merits.
issues.respondent_position: Port Authority does not deny the discretion exists but says circumstances do not warrant it; FSD takes no position.
issues.result_quote: I am of the view that this appeal is moot and that we should not exercise our discretion to decide the matter.

issues.issue: Does the Port Authority's bonus scheme create a reasonable apprehension of bias in approving the FSD project?
issues.applicant_position: Bonuses tied to predetermined objectives gave executives a pecuniary incentive to approve the FSD project.
issues.respondent_position: Decisions were fair and untainted by bias; the allegation is fact-dependent, and the judge so found.
issues.result_quote: I am of the view that this appeal is moot and that we should not exercise our discretion to decide the matter.
